name: American IronHorse
engine: 107 to 124 cubic inch S&S or TP V-twin, carb or fuel injection, belt drive
intro: American IronHorse's production customs. S&S engines and wide rear tires, from a company that closed in 2008.

L: Custom builders used S&S or similar engines, so most engine parts are available. Frame, bodywork and wiring parts are another matter; photograph everything before you take it apart.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
